title: Research climate change, risks and ECB strategy: what is the effect on European banks’ stock return?
core_idea: Assess how ECB climate-related announcements influence banks' stock market performance by applying an event-study methodology on narrow event windows. The study examines responses to five specific announcements, compares effects across European banks, eurozone banks, and ECB-supervised institutions, and evaluates the type (positive or negative) and intensity of market reactions.
tldr: Uses an event-study to evaluate how ECB climate communications affect European banks' stock returns, comparing multiple announcements and bank groups to understand response direction and strength.
